context_excerpt: 2024-07-24 **Event**: Exchange A announced on July 24 that it would remove Company A from Index B, with the decision to officially take effect on July 29. Affected by this news, the company's Market A price fell 8% that day. Company A had only just been included in the index in July of this year, and this removal came only five months after its inclusion. Company E, Company F, and Company G would replace Company A, C…

time.desc: The exchange announced that a technology company will be removed from the main index. The decision will officially take effect in a few days.
The founder of a well-known short-selling agency announced the dissolution of the agency, saying that the phased tasks have been completed
Technology companies confirm they will submit delayed annual financial reports before regulatory cutoffs, directly mitigating forced delisting risks
Technology company updates plan to maintain listing status, expected to file delayed annual and quarterly financial reports ahead of regulatory cutoff

The technology company successfully avoided a delisting crisis by submitting overdue annual and quarterly financial reports to the regulatory agency, and the exchange confirmed that it once again complied with listing filing requirements.
Technology company announces appointment of new independent director, promotion to general counsel and senior vice president of corporate development
Technology companies release quarterly unaudited financial results, with net profits and gross profit margins falling sharply

Share prices of technology companies plummeted after announcing quarterly financial reports. Both revenue and gross profit margin fell short of expectations, and full-year revenue estimates were significantly lowered.
Technology company discloses to regulators that its internal control over financial reporting had material weaknesses and failed to operate effectively
Technology executives submit revised reports on changes in insider ownership to regulators, adding additional disclosures on previously omitted indirect holdings

The co-founder and CEO of a technology company has been arrested and faces multiple federal criminal charges for allegedly illegally smuggling high-end chips into a country through a network of affiliated companies.
Tech company announces board member resigns as director, appoints acting chief compliance officer
Two independent directors of a technology company launched an independent investigation to investigate whether employees were suspected of smuggling chips to a certain country.
Brokerage analysts downgrade technology company stock ratings and target prices, criticizing companies for being passive rather than proactive in compliance adjustments
Technology company board announces appointment of lead independent director to lead internal investigation, assisted by audit committee chair

The company disclosed its fiscal year results. Net profit increased significantly year-on-year, revenue doubled, but gross profit margin declined, and it confirmed that there was no need to restate the statement.

The market questioned that many of the company's senior executives accurately reduced their holdings to cash out during the delay in the annual report and the stock price changes, and the stock price subsequently plummeted.
Accounting Firm A, the original auditor of Company A, resigned from the audit job and expressed concerns about the internal control and governance of its financial reporting.

The president and CEO of Company A forecast for the first time that forward fiscal year revenue will reach approximately 40 billion currency units, and also lowered the revenue forecast for this fiscal year.
After Company A submitted its overdue financial report and lifted the risk of delisting, its stock price soared by more than 24% in after-hours trading.
Company A disclosed that its gross profit margin for the fiscal year fell from approximately 18% to approximately 13.8%, putting the quality of earnings under pressure.

After Company A completed the submission of all overdue documents, its stock price soared by more than 23% after the market closed. It plummeted by nearly 12% during the session as the delisting cutoff approached.
